response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack development skills and experience with diverse technologies, including distributed systems and infrastructure. However, his background lacks direct alignment with the core requirements of the role, particularly in C++ and large-scale cloud compute platforms, and his leadership experience is more informal than explicitly technical.
strengths: Extensive experience with distributed systems and infrastructure, including micro-services and real-time data processing.
Proven ability to lead open-source projects and mentor others through workshops and talks.
Diverse technical background spanning web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems, with a focus on testability and user experience.
concerns: Lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience, with only limited exposure in early roles.
No explicit experience in technical leadership roles for cloud compute platforms or DevOps teams.
Primary expertise lies in full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js) rather than the low-level systems programming emphasized in the role.
